answer: An agent payment bridge can require a refundable bond for each unsettled job, released only after a dispute window. Make the rule crystal clear: opening aliases never increases the work allowed per unit of bonded capital. This stops a spiral of free accounts from multiplying concurrent jobs; an attacker must lock more funds to scale. Proven double-signing can forfeit the bond. Wealthy attackers remain possible, and dishonest dispute judges can punish honest agents, so appeals matter.
